    Auslander–Reiten sequences starting at a module #

    Left minimal left almost split maps exist (exists_minimal_leftAS). If U admits a non-split monomorphism (U is not injective), a left almost split map out of U is injective (injective_of_leftAS). For an injective left minimal left almost split f : U → E, the cokernel map E → E / f U is right almost split (isRightAS_coker, by a pullback argument) and its target is nonzero indecomposable (isIndecMod_of_rightAS). This is the sequence 0 → U → E → τ⁻¹U → 0.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.AR.exists_arSeqL {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] (U : FDMod k A) [IsLocalRing (Module.End A U.carrier)] (W : FDMod k A) (ι : U ⟶ W) (hι : Function.Injective ⇑(FDMod.lin ι)) (hns : ¬∃ (r : W ⟶ U), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ι r = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id U) :
    ∃ (E : FDMod k A) (f : U ⟶ E), IsLeftAS f ∧ Function.Injective ⇑(FDMod.lin f) ∧ (∀ (φ : E ⟶ E), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f φ = f → Function.Bijective ⇑(FDMod.lin φ)) ∧ IsRightAS (have this := FDMod.ofLin (FDMod.lin f).range.mkQ; this) ∧ IndNT (E.ofQuot (FDMod.lin f).range)

    Auslander–Reiten sequences starting at a non-injective module: for U with local endomorphism ring admitting a non-split monomorphism, there is 0 → U → E → V → 0 with f injective, left almost split and left minimal, E → V right almost split, and V nonzero indecomposable (V = τ⁻¹U).
